resources.string: Nationwide and local Volán buses, BKK and HÉV services included in the BKK feed. Rail timetables can be added by importing an authorized GTFS file.

Optional download, at most 500 MB. Installation temporarily needs at least 1.5 GB free. Scheduled stop-to-stop planning uses only source-provided transfer links. No live vehicles, delays or address search. The bundled offline map is described below.
Without an internet connection, the app automatically uses the downloaded pack and returns online when connectivity is restored. Manually enabled offline mode stays enabled.
Download the pack before enabling offline mode.

The pack and downloaded source files will be deleted. Offline mode will be disabled. Favorites are kept. The local map working copy is removed after the map closes; the bundled map remains part of the app.
Downloading — can resume when a network is available
